STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_127318.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_127318.v · Open raw
module origen_127318 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire [255:0] data_in,
    input wire [7:0] sel,
    input wire upstream_valid,
    output wire upstream_ready,
    output wire [7:0] result,
    output wire downstream_valid,
    input wire downstream_ready
);

    reg [7:0] accumulator;
    reg [2:0] cycle_count;
    wire mux_out;
    wire [7:0] acc_out;
    reg acc_valid;

    // 256-to-1 multiplexer
    assign mux_out = data_in[sel];

    // Accumulator
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            accumulator <= 8'b0;
            cycle_count <= 3'b0;
            acc_valid <= 1'b0;
        end else if (upstream_valid && upstream_ready) begin
            accumulator <= (cycle_count == 3'b111) ? mux_out : accumulator + mux_out;
            cycle_count <= cycle_count + 1'b1;
            acc_valid <= (cycle_count == 3'b111);
        end
    end

    assign acc_out = accumulator;

    // Final output module
    reg [7:0] final_result;
    reg final_valid;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            final_result <= 8'b0;
            final_valid <= 1'b0;
        end else if (acc_valid) begin
            final_result <= acc_out;
            final_valid <= 1'b1;
        end else if (downstream_ready && downstream_valid) begin
            final_valid <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    assign result = final_result;
    assign downstream_valid = final_valid;
    assign upstream_ready = !final_valid || downstream_ready;

endmodule
